subject: Important Update: Your Flight Reservation
body: Dear [Name], we are writing to inform you of a schedule change to your upcoming flight reservation. Due to unforeseen circumstances, your flight has been rescheduled to depart one hour earlier than originally planned. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and kindly ask you to confirm your availability for the new timing. Please let us know at your earliest convenience. Thank you for choosing our airline for your travel needs.
